field_declaration.nullable: Allow an explicitly present JSON null value.
field_declaration.privacy: Optional field privacy override; otherwise inherit entity privacy.
field_declaration.required: Whether a declared field must be present when an import creates a Node; key-matched updates may omit it and retain the current value.
field_declaration.searchable: Index string values for local memory_search_manage action=text, independent of privacy.
field_declaration.type: Optional enforced JSON type; omit to keep the field dynamic.

guide.errors: Failures have code/message/details/retryable. Never silently change memories after an error.

operations.analysis: memory_ingest_manage writes analytical attributes and caller metrics. Use canonical Node IDs; caller metrics are immutable.
operations.configure: memory_configure create initializes; attach validates. SQLite uses database/evidence_root. PostgreSQL uses connection_env/schema/evidence_root. Absolute paths; connection_env is a variable name, never a DSN value.
operations.describe: memory_ontology_manage declares descriptions, privacy and validation. Imports can introduce undeclared fields.
operations.import: memory_ingest_manage jsonl_import reads server-local JSONL objects. An ordered typed key matches current Nodes. Required declared fields must be present when a record creates a Node; key-matched updates may omit required fields and patch only present fields.
operations.join: memory_relation_manage materialize creates typed exact joins. Source arrays expand unique non-null values/combinations; targets are scalar. No inferred or automatic joins.
operations.provenance: Results carry record/source/run/fragment IDs. memory_explain_manage resolves provenance; evidence managers provide bounded status/reads/verification.
operations.query: memory_query_manage execute accepts v1/v2. Read memory://schema/query-ir/current; use exact ontology names.
operations.native_analytics: analysis_execute runs named queries/inspection in one snapshot. V2 has anchored optional groups, identity counts, integer sums and exact ratios. query_drill_down requires typed key, measure and original state on every live page.
operations.capture: Save only when requested: memory_ingest_manage analysis_capture takes analysis/definition_version/expected_state. Server computes values. analysis_read reports freshness; saved drill uses observation_id/query_name.

guide.purpose: Use the local MCP memory without database access. Resources describe shape; typed tools perform bounded operations.

results.common: Every data-operation result includes memory. Check it before reusing IDs. Fingerprints identify contracts; provenance IDs are not business keys.
results.evidence: availability=present/missing; verification=unverified/verified/corrupt. Read base64 chunks until eof. Incomplete/truncated audits are bounded subsets.
results.import: records counts lines; created_nodes/updated_nodes split upserts; attributes_written counts present fields; ontology_delta describes new shape.
results.join: created_relations counts new edges; skipped_unmatched/skipped_null_or_missing explain omissions.
results.query: V1 rows bind aliases and project values/provenance; count is separate. truncated means more output rows exist.
results.replay: replayed=true returns the already committed canonical IDs/counts.
results.search: Matches contain target IDs/provenance; coverage compares eligible and indexed facts.
results.traversal: Nodes/edges carry depth; truncation is explicit. Explain or deactivate relation_id.
results.native_analytics: Native envelopes use format_version/result. Complete input precedes output pagination; limits abort. Ratios retain exact integers; coverage references global measures, never caller counts.

safety.correction: Deactivate relations explicitly; evidence checks append history.
safety.destructive: Node deletion cascades current graph/search/embeddings, retaining immutable evidence.
safety.privacy: Data defaults public. Private facts are excluded from public export/external embedding; local reads can see them. Semantic query text is external.
safety.native_observations: Fact/provenance changes stale captures. Native public=true requires current verified public captured/current dependencies. Referenced manifests are mandatory. Restored observations have unknown freshness.

selection.default: Omit memory for the environment-selected default.
selection.named: Use the same explicit name on every call. No active selection or fallback.

workflow.action: Read memory://catalog and choose one memory; read its summary for content discovery. Empty default does not imply empty named memories.
Read action-linked specs. Use memory://operations for unknown operations, capabilities for availability and ontology for data names.
Follow the exact payload schema and example from the selected operation spec.
For writes, read memory://schema/current and pass schema_fingerprint as contract_fingerprint.
For execute, read memory://schema/query-ir/current and use exact ontology names.
Refresh the selected ontology after shape-changing writes.

server_instructions: Use plugin tools for memory data; no shell checks. Read catalog/specs with memory_discover. Payloads are JSON objects.
